name: Series-troxide
tagline: A Simple and Modern Series Tracker
description: Series Troxide a Simple and Modern Series Tracker

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/series-troxide:0.5.1@sha256:a86c0f9b6500be2596e3fdf12bf3b341f6b842c1b1fc88d44b6ef3362f9b58df
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
